title: THE PASSIONATE GUIDE TO CHO'GATH JUNGLE
author: LeonAtreides

Lillia.summary: The author considers her overwhelming for Cho'Gath jungle and simply recommends banning her.

Vayne.summary: The guide's build lets you fight her off reasonably well. Try to shut her down early; if that fails, you can still outplay her with the build and good execution.

Trundle.summary: Unless he is behind or misplays, expect to lose duels against him. A well-placed Q lets you escape if he has no Flash. In teamfights, lock him down for your team and look to execute him with your ult.

Belveth.summary: A dangerous hypercarry who snowballs off small mistakes. She is weak in teamfights, squishy and vulnerable to CC that disrupts her spells, so group up and run her over.

Shyvana.summary: She out-farms you no matter what. Your best option is to catch her while she is distracted on a camp and hope she misplays.
